shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view for a developer account.
fullDescription: Implements the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a dark GitHub-style top header, profile navigation tabs, a left profile summary column, a popular repositories grid, and a yearly contribution heatmap with interactive year selection. The view accepts state, activeTab, and selectedYear arguments and keeps visible tabs, search, buttons, and year selection immediately usable through local presentational state.
